purpose: Simulation-only economic prior adaptation; not structural estimation

calibration.interpretation: Dimensional anchors only; fare anchor is NOT an estimated no-surge fare, and count is NOT unconstrained demand.

simulation_metadata.real_panel_hash_note: Hash identifies source file, but only rows before explicit training cutoff influence scale calibration.
simulation_metadata.calendar: Synthetic timestamps are calendar coordinates, not claims of observed historical events. UTC storage, NYC-local calendar features.

columns.fare: Synthetic completed-trip median, NaN below10 completions
columns.posted_fare: Current offered common rider price; not a training target substitute

limitations: Hourly queue approximation is for a forecasting demonstration, not minute-level dispatch optimization.
No causal inference about Uber, no Uber One membership mechanism, no competitor behavior, and no welfare or profit estimate.
Revenue means gross rider fares on completed rides before driver payments and operating costs.
Policy comparisons use the same exogenous paths and rider-choice uniforms. Differences are model-dependent, not empirical treatment effects.
A lower synthetic training loss is not evidence of improved real-world forecasting; real holdout evaluation remains necessary.

batch_note: Native sampler appends whole seven-channel tasks until requested batch size 8 is met, hence two tasks / fourteen series.
target: Synthetic realized median rider fare, with low-count target hours masked
sampler: Uniform trajectory sampling with replacement and random contiguous cut; not all passed trajectories are guaranteed observed in 60 steps
training_data_policy: Only the synthetic NPZ is loaded. No NYC validation or test panel enters gradient updates.
selection_policy: Root benchmark evaluates step0,30,60 on February validation only before selecting one for March. No test-driven changes.
